record_type_quote: Derived from these research questions, the study pursues the overarching aim to determine whether the latent class structure of community-dwelling informal dementia care dyads, characterized in a previous German data set, replicates in a structurally similar but distinct Dutch sample of individuals living with dementia and their informal caregivers.

targets.authors: Wiegelmann H, Wolf-Ostermann K, Brannath W, Arzideh F, Dreyer J, Thyrian R, et al.
targets.title: Sociodemographic aspects and health care-related outcomes: a latent class analysis of informal dementia care dyads.
targets.evidence_quote: The present study is designed as a replication of a previous LCA, which was carried out with baseline data of the German DemNet-D study [ 22 ].
targets.outcome_quote: However, the findings of the present study confirm those of the original LCA and emphasize that relevant subgroups of informal dementia care dyads exist.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors give an overall confirmation of the original LCA findings. This overall verdict takes precedence over the subsequent acknowledged differences and two unrecovered classes.

reasoning: A distinct Dutch sample is used to re-test the published German LCA results, despite analysis of existing cohort data.
